instruction: Sort invoices according to vendor, then create a 'tech_vendors' folder on the Desktop and transfer all Tech Innovators Inc. invoices into it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires reading invoice PDFs to identify which are from Tech Innovators Inc. From the invoice data: (1) Invoice TII-20220301-90 is from 'Tech Innovators Inc., 350 Tech Park, San Jose, CA 95134, USA', (2) Invoice GES-20220215-82 is from 'Green Energy Solutions', (3) Invoice #243729 is from 'Staples Office Supplies'. The evaluator checks if the tech_vendors folder contains the invoice from Tech Innovators Inc. (invoice TII-20220301-90.pdf).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) if the invoice from Tech Innovators Inc. (invoice TII-20220301-90.pdf) exists in /home/user/Desktop/tech_vendors/ folder AND does not exist in /home/user/Desktop/ (i.e., it was moved, not copied). Score 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly checks BOTH conditions: file exists at new path (line 44-46) AND file does NOT exist at old path (line 49-51)
Metric logic correctly verifies move operation by requiring both conditions to be true (line 37: actual_moved = exists_at_new_path AND not_exists_at_old_path)
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict with two booleans, metric receives and evaluates both correctly
Expected value {'file_moved': true} is semantically correct for this task
Evaluator properly distinguishes between move and copy operations (would fail if file still exists at old path)
Minor limitation: Does not verify that other vendor invoices (GES, Staples) remain on Desktop, but instruction only requires moving Tech Innovators invoices
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding optional verification that non-Tech Innovators invoices (Invoice # GES-20220215-82.pdf, Invoice # 243729.pdf) remain on Desktop and are not in tech_vendors folder for more comprehensive validation
